## What's new in 1.3.0

**Two more releases: fourteen in all, 314 modules.** Both are Delrina's own collections of 1994 for Intermission, the screen saver engine Star Wars Screen Entertainment ran on.

| Release | Year | Modules |
|---|---|---|
| The Far Side Screen Saver Collection | 1994 | 14 |
| Scott Adams' Dilbert Screen Saver Collection | 1994 | 16 |

Most of their modules are animations, played by Intermission's own animation player, which Long After Dark now runs unchanged, as it runs the modules. Each module has a **Configure...** button that opens its original options. The importer takes both from your own copies, including a ZIP of each install disk's files, and can download them from the Internet Archive. For The Far Side that is a 1994 copy of its five floppies, the only intact one online.

Three modules that took the mouse under Intermission (The Far Side's Pterodactyl, Dilbert's Best of Dilbert and Budget Woes) run as ordinary screen savers: input ends them.
